resources.string: Select your original USA raw game disc image (.bin). CUE sheets and ISO images are not supported. The selected file will be copied to app-private storage.

Your original USA game disc image (.bin) is required. CUE sheets and ISO images are not supported.\n\nChoose the raw .bin file using the document picker. VanillaBTN copies it to app-private storage for the game and save data.
Copying game disc to app-private storage…
Please select the original USA raw game disc image ending in .bin. CUE sheets and ISO images are not supported.
The selected file is too small to be a game disc image. Please choose the complete .bin file.

Failed to copy game disc. Please ensure your device has at least 700 MB of free storage space.
